Notify.NoToken: Range Finder: this actor has no token on the current scene.

Preview.Name: Preview hovered range
Preview.Hint: Hold while hovering an item, attack or spell row to preview its range.

Clear.Name: Clear my ranges
Clear.Hint: Clear your pinned ranges and previews.

ClearShared.Name: Clear shared ranges (GM)
ClearShared.Hint: Clear every shared range for all players.

showLabels.Name: Range Finder: band labels
showLabels.Hint: Show distance and penalty labels on band edges.

badgeScale.Name: Range Finder: badge size
badgeScale.Hint: Size of the distance badges above tokens.

palette.Name: Range Finder: colors
palette.Hint: Color palette for bands and badges.

dimBehindWalls.Name: Range Finder: dim behind walls
dimBehindWalls.Hint: Hatch squares and mark targets without line of effect from the token. Range itself is unchanged.

ghostMode.Name: Range Finder: hide windows while showing range
ghostMode.Hint: What happens to the sheet or HUD window a range was shown from.

ghostPersistentHud.Name: Range Finder: also hide PF2e HUD bar
ghostPersistentHud.Hint: When a range is shown from PF2e HUD, only its sidebar fades. Also fade the persistent bar.

allowSharing.Name: Range Finder: allow sharing
allowSharing.Hint: Let players Shift+click to show a range to everyone.

badgesCombatOnly.Name: Range Finder: badges only in combat
badgesCombatOnly.Hint: Only show distance badges on combatants of the active combat.

rangeField.Name: Range Finder: range field (other systems)
rangeField.Hint: Item data path holding the range, e.g. system.range.value. A number, or { value, long }. Leave empty to auto-detect system.range. Not used by PF2e, SF2e or D&D 5e.

tokenHudButton.Name: Range Finder: Token HUD button
tokenHudButton.Hint: Show a 📏 button on the Token HUD that lists the token's ranges.
